[Question 9(c)]  
12. At 1502 hours, there was a rapid spread of fire among different façades of Wang Cheong House, and the mid-lower level of east façade of Wang Tai House was well alight. At the time of my arrival, I observed that there were no evacuees from the front entrance of Wang Cheong House. In view of the fire development and potential large number of residents trapped therein, I upgraded the fire to No. 3 Alarm, so as to request additional manpower and appliances resources to the scene.

[Question 7(a)]  
13. After my upgrade of fire to No. 3 Alarm, I noted a number of residents evacuating from various buildings. I directed my crew members to evacuate them to place of safety. At about 1503 hours, I received a message from the FSCC of an assistance call at Room 2701 of Wang Cheong House. I thus ordered Probationary Station Officer LIAO Kong-lap (“PStnO LIAO”), Oic of Major Pump (“MP”) of Sha Tin Fire Station (“ST/MP”), to handle this assistance call. PStnO LIAO instructed Senior Fireman (Posthumous) 18469 HO Wai-ho (“SFn HO”), Fireman 17569 YEUNG Ching and Fireman 22662 SIU Tsz-ho of Light Rescue Unit of Sha Tin Fire Station (“ST/LRU”) to respond to this assistance call. At the same time, I noted that the Rubbish Collection Point on the ground floor of Wang Fuk Court was well alight due to the burning flying embers. As the fire was close to TP/HP posing an imminent danger to it, I directed crew members of TP/HP to extinguish that fire.

[Question 9(a) continued]  
14. At about 1505 hours, a large quantity of burning bamboo, wooden planks, and miscellaneous articles continued to fall from height of Wang Cheong House. These burning articles piled up and blocked the front entrance of Wang Cheong House. I deployed 3 additional water jets for extinguishing the fire at the façades of Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House facing the roundabout, and that on the open ground near the front entrance of Wang Cheong House. Attempts were made simultaneously to remove the blockage at the same time.

15. As at 1505 hours, different façades of Wang Cheong House (with both the front entrance and rear exit blocked), the open ground near the front entrance of Wang Cheong House, and the mid-lower level of the east façade of Wang Tai House were well alight. In total, I deployed 5 water jets for Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House.
